notes.title: Update Notice for Version 0.1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288983/9c5f7be11197e6fdb665dc7872daf6f5e40eb0ab.jpg[/img]

Update Notice for Version 0.1.0

Dear players,

Last Remains will release the Version 0.1.0 update soon.
To ensure server stability, the servers will undergo maintenance on May 22, 2025, starting at 0:00 AM and are expected to reopen by 12:00 PM UTC+8. 
Below are the details of the update:

1.New PVE Solo Survival Challenge Mode

Supports creating new save files, and the data is independent from the PVP system.
Starts with 4 characters and 2 backpacks. Backpacks can be equipped via the warehouse.
If a character dies, you'll return to the lobby to switch to another one. If all characters die, this save fails. 
(Note: All obtained gear, characters, and upgrades will be wiped when the save fails.)
Items found in-game can be brought back to the starting area and stored in the warehouse or extracted via helicopter to the safe house.
All equipment can be equipped or sold via Lobby > Warehouse.
Gold coins earned from selling items can be used to open loot boxes for common equipment/characters.
Keys brought out from matches can be used to open loot boxes for high-grade equipment/characters.
Silver coins earned can be used to upgrade the Training Camp.

2.24 New Weapon Skins Added

3.Comprehensive Combat Animation Optimization

4.Backpack System Overhaul
Items can now be split into separate stacks.
Weapons will automatically switch to your backup weapon when durability runs out.
Items can be freely dragged to discard, equip, or move them.

5.Silver Items in PVP Will Now Be Retained Even If You Fail to Escape

6.New Ranked System
Ranking points are now calculated with a refined system: each of the 5 major ranks is subdivided into 10 tiers.
Silver items will no longer be lost upon character death and will still contribute to ranking points.
Ranking point gains upon successful extraction will decrease as your rank increases.

7.Player Names Will No Longer Be Displayed on the In-Game Leaderboard, add team voice

8. PVP Balance Adjustments
Weapon stats have been rebalanced.
Improved attribute growth for characters ranked A, B, C, and D.
Character usage system has been changed from usage-count to time-base, all existing characters will start with 90 days of usage.
After the update:
S-rank characters = 90 days
D-rank characters = 50 days
Each character shard adds 3 days of usage time.

9. Anti-Cheat System Upgraded
Added more cheat detection and banning methods.

10. Map and Environment Optimizations
Fixed void fall-through bugs in Eling Park and Monument maps.
Optimized the number and placement of props indoors and outdoors.
Improved vegetation for better performance.
Adjusted building layouts to reduce blockage caused by glass doors.

Please log in to the game and claim your season rewards from the mailbox in the PVP lobby after the update.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288983/811cc22631391cbfdf6607aa99f19175e8aa3d08.jpg[/img]

notes.title: May New Season Update Preview
notes.content:
May New Season Update Preview

Dear players,
This is the Last Remains development team.

Thank you all for your patience and continued support. Below is the preview of the upcoming new season update:

I. Update Schedule
The game will undergo maintenance and server downtime on May 22 for this update.

II. Update Highlights

1. New Solo PvE Survival Challenge
   A new PvE mode for solo players is now available, which is separate from the present PvP system.

2. Over 20 New Weapon Skins Added

3. New Silver Coin Guarantee Mechanism for Failed Extractions

4. New Ranked Tier System
The amount of points earned from successful extractions will decrease as your rank increases.

5. Comprehensive Melee Combat Optimization
Improved melee animations and rebalanced weapon damage values.

6. In-Game Backpack UI Improvements
  Players can now choose the quantity of items to drop.

7. Character usage will now be tracked by days instead of number of uses

8. Game performance upgrade, Frames per second major improvement

III. End-of-Season Reset Details

1. Season 1 Ends
The first season will conclude at **11:59:59 PM on May 21, 2025.
  Matches successfully extracted in Ranked mode after this time will not earn any points.

2. Season 2 Ranked Points Reset
Accounts with 20,000 points or less: No change.
  Accounts with more than 20,000 points: Reset to 20,000 points.

3. Training Camp / Battle Pass / Character Levels & XP will all be reset.

More details and gameplay breakdowns will be shared in the near future.
We truly appreciate all the feedback and suggestions from our players, and we’ll strive to continuous update and optimize. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Dear players
notes.content:
Dear players,

Since the Early Access launch on February 18th, the game has garnered significant attention and feedback. Through livestreams, videos, community discussions, and support channels, we’ve gathered a wealth of player opinions. We’ve come to realize that many players are drawn to the game primarily because of its post-apocalyptic survival setting in a modern Chinese city—a theme best expressed through PVE or cooperative gameplay (GVE).

After careful consideration, we’ve decided to scrap the originally planned "new player tutorial" feature and instead develop a full-fledged PVE mode. While we could have simply repurposed the existing gameplay into a basic PVE experience, we felt that approach wouldn’t be engaging enough. As a result, we had to delay the next update until May, and we sincerely apologize for the wait.

The originally scheduled mid-April tutorial update will now evolve into "Solo Survival Challenge 1.0"—a completely standalone single-player mode. In this mode, players must struggle to survive in a collapsing world, pushing their limits to last as long as possible. If a character dies, players must switch to another; if all characters perish, the challenge ends. Players will start in a randomized safehouse and can stockpile scavenged weapons, food, water, and other supplies. However, as time passes, zombie hordes will grow stronger, and resources will dwindle. Future updates will introduce local co-op survival (though host PCs will need to meet certain hardware requirements).

The existing PVP/PVE mode will continue developing alongside the new single-player content. While the two modes will share some assets, their progression and gameplay will remain completely separate, allowing players to freely choose their preferred experience.

Additionally, we are planning a story-driven campaign mode, where players will explore Chongqing’s ruins through the perspectives of original characters, uncovering the game’s lore while immersing themselves in a uniquely Chinese zombie apocalypse. This mode will be released in phases, with the full version potentially taking six months to a year to complete. Rest assured, we will see it through. Last Remains will carve out its own identity—a fresh narrative in the survival genre.

Finally, we’d like to share some heartfelt words: Thank you for all your feedback, whether encouraging or critical. Every complaint, every piece of advice, even the anger—it’s all valid. In this era of big data, we see your livestreams, videos, and discussions. The praise warms our hearts, and the criticism keeps us grounded. That’s why we’ve made this major decision—one almost akin to a full reboot.

We won’t let you down.

—Last Remains Dev Team

notes.title: 0.0.6 version update
notes.content:
0.0.6 version update

The update will start at 6:00 am on March 22 (Saturday) Beijing time

1. Optimize the matching mechanism. Players with high and low rankings will be in different games.
2. Add absolute solo matching. If the player does not check the automatic team formation and does not have a team match, he will enter the absolute solo room.
3. Add a naming system in the game to detect duplicate names.
4. You can turn off the voice in the settings so that you will not hear the voices of other players.
5. Add a new activity, which will be held from 21:00 to 24:00 every night. This is an attempt at an activity. If it is good, we will regularly do some interesting activities in the future.
6. Optimize the arrival time of the helicopter, so that the time when the escape rope lands is consistent with the arrival time of the helicopter displayed on the UI.
7. Zombie adjustment:
Subdivide the zombie AI type to make its behavior more consistent with the appearance characteristics, for example:
Security zombie patrols faster and is less likely to get rid of, but the pursuit speed is slower
Nurse zombie has good hearing and likes to chase closely, but the damage is lower
Etc.
In addition, the new boss zombie has entered the final development and debugging
8. Scene optimization
Modify the problem of missing material balls of some building walls,
Modify the material balls of some props,
Modify the collision problem of some props such as the dining car,
Fix the problem of falling into the void in the stairwell of the construction site,
Replace all the trees in the scene,
Added the Harguo prop. I want to make an edible food for this prop in the future. Eating it may trigger one of the following random effects. If you have better ideas, you can also leave a message in the comment area
Excitement: You will not lose stamina if you do anything within 20 seconds
Increase or decrease HP
Increase or decrease satiety/drinking degree
Eating before mutation will increase or decrease the infection value; eating after mutation will increase or decrease the mutation time

A major update originally planned for the end of March will be postponed to mid-April:
8 stand-alone novice tasks will gradually familiarize you with the gameplay and give startup rewards
New slice map, more compact game, I hope to increase the frame rate
All melee actions are fully optimized, the role of different weapons is rebalanced, and the combat game will change
New weapon skin

notes.title: Equipment Attributes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288983/10f9887537dba2560eb0b4f348e6954c1ea03be1.png[/img]


Clothing Attributes
1.Movement Speed – Increases running speed. This attribute appears only on pants, shoes, and headgear. (S-tier: +13% movement speed)
2.Stealth Speed – Increases crouch walking speed. This attribute appears on pants, shoes, headgear, and face gear. (S-tier: +15% stealth speed)
3.Max Stamina – Increases maximum stamina, affecting running, attacking, dodging, climbing, and jumping. When the stamina bar is red, many actions cannot be performed properly. This attribute appears on pants, shoes, headgear, and face gear. (S-tier: +18 max stamina)
4.Max HP – Increases maximum health. This attribute appears on outerwear, underwear, gloves, and headgear. (S-tier: +17 max HP)
5.Strength – Increases melee weapon damage and throwing damage. Every 10 points of Strength increase damage by approximately 4%. This attribute appears on outerwear, underwear, and gloves. (S-tier: +17 Strength)
6.Luck – Increases the drop rate weight of S-tier and A-tier equipment. Each point of Luck adds a 0.1% increase in drop rate. This attribute appears on shoes, headgear, gloves, and face gear. (S-tier: +5 Luck)
7.Max Hunger – Increases maximum hunger. This attribute appears on underwear, gloves, headgear, and face gear. (S-tier: +26 max hunger)
8.Max Thirst – Increases maximum thirst. This attribute appears on outerwear, shoes, headgear, and face gear. (S-tier: +26 max thirst)
9.Bullet Resistance – Reduces bullet damage by a percentage. This attribute appears on outerwear, underwear, and pants. (S-tier: -13% bullet damage)
10.Blunt Resistance – Reduces blunt weapon (hammers, maces) damage by a percentage. This attribute appears on outerwear, underwear, and pants. (S-tier: -13% blunt damage)
11.Sharp Resistance – Reduces sharp weapon (daggers, axes, two-handed swords) damage by a percentage. This attribute appears on outerwear, underwear, and pants. (S-tier: -13% sharp damage)
12.Backpack Carrying Capacity – Increases the character's carry weight (in kg). This attribute appears only on backpacks. (Currently, backpacks only have this attribute. We plan to add base weight capacity and additional attributes like Luck and Defense in the future.)
Weapon Attributes
1.Weapon Damage – Increases the weapon’s normal attack damage. (Max: +20%)
2.Sprint Attack Damage – Increases the weapon’s sprint attack damage. (Max: +28%)
3.Charged Attack Damage – Increases the weapon’s charged attack damage. (Max: +28%)
4.Jump Attack Damage – Increases the weapon’s jumping attack damage. (Max: +28%)
5.Throwing Damage – Increases the weapon’s throwing damage. (Max: +28%)
6.Headshot Damage – Increases the weapon’s headshot damage in addition to the normal headshot bonus. (Max: +30%)
7.Durability – Increases the weapon’s durability. (Max: +30%)
8.Durability Consumption – Reduces the rate at which the weapon loses durability. (Max: -50%)
9.Fire Rate – Increases the shooting speed of ranged weapons. (Max: +18%)
10.Reload Speed – Increases the speed of reloading ranged weapons. (Max: +30%)
11.ADS Movement Speed – Increases movement speed while aiming down sights. (Max: +30%)
12.Reduced Gunfire Noise – Reduces gunfire noise and decreases the duration of the red marker on the map when firing. (Max: -30%)

notes.title: "Last Remains" Project Report and Outlook
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288983/6ee14939fcfcb40c236b2864bb2615e704d32fac.jpg[/img]

Last Remains Project Report and Future Outlook

Ongoing Work:
1. Smoother Combat
We are optimizing all melee animations to improve responsiveness and make key feedback more immediate. Additionally, we are adjusting some combat animations to balance weapons and enhance the overall fighting experience (e.g., reducing the startup and recovery frames of five melee actions while preventing infinite combos).
2. Randomized Maps
The current large map will be divided into smaller sections, ensuring that each time players enter the game, they are placed in a randomly generated mini-map. The maximum number of players and zombies will be reduced, leading to significantly improved performance. We estimate an increase of 20-40 FPS on all PC configurations.
3. PvE Story Mode
New players can first experience a pure PvE story mode to familiarize themselves with the game mechanics and immerse themselves in the zombie world in single-player mode. The story mode will feature multiple mission-based scenarios and various challenges. Completing these missions will earn rewards, helping players progress more quickly and transition smoothly through the early stages of the game.


Future Plans:
1. World Boss
A world boss will randomly appear in certain areas of the game. All players will be notified and can team up to take on this massive enemy. PvP will be temporarily disabled in the boss area. Defeating this incredible threat will grant high-value rewards.
2. Improved New Player Experience & Story Mode
To enhance the onboarding experience, we are developing a brand-new story mode to give players clearer objectives at the start of the game. This mode will offer a more streamlined, accessible, and engaging early-game experience.
3. Drones
A customizable drone system will be introduced, serving multiple purposes in the game. These abilities include reconnaissance, disrupting enemies, distracting zombies, and transporting high-value items (similar to secure containers in Escape from Tarkov).
This will be a deep progression system, requiring players to gather materials in-game to upgrade different drone functions.
Drones will offer more options for players who frequently struggle with extraction.
4. Random Events
Various random events will be triggered in-game. Some will be PvE missions requiring teamwork, while others will be PvP missions encouraging competition for rewards. These dynamic events will provide endless gameplay possibilities.
Example: Treasure Map Mission – Players must find and piece together sections of a treasure map to locate hidden treasure within the environment. However, while multiple maps exist, only one real treasure is available. Players must race against competitors to claim it first. Clues will be provided throughout the process, making interactions with the environment more engaging and rewarding.
5. More Elite Zombies
Over time, new types of elite zombies will be introduced, adding fresh challenges to PvE gameplay. Some planned variations include:Ranged Elite, Fast Nocturnal Elite, Flying Elite, Wall-Climbing Elite.
Players will need to think strategically and creatively to survive. Understanding the environment and adapting tactics will be key to success.

notes.title: About plug-in complaints and handling
notes.content:
The game has just been launched, and we found that there are plug-ins for sale on major platforms, and there are also enthusiastic players who report it. We have noticed this problem and dealt with it as soon as possible. Please protect your property and don't be deceived.

The pleasure brought by cheating in PVP games is not comparable to that of stand-alone games. Huge profits will induce some people to try to make profits through plug-ins. The official has made anti-plug-in designs, and they will be dealt with in time as long as they are found. However, there will always be fish that slip through the net. If you find suspicious players in the game, and other platforms have such software for sale, you can report it to the official customer service QQ or send an email to lastremains@vip.qq.com, preferably with a video or screenshot, we will handle every case.

Here we also advise players who want to use plug-ins that we have zero tolerance for plug-ins. Once discovered, they will be banned for 1-7 days at the lightest and permanently banned at the worst.

notes.title: Last Remains Early Access published!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288983/35174581e4d2de66c17a679f8579c648a3d25318.jpg[/img]

The EA version of "Last Remains" is officially released! Thank you for your support along the way!

Dear players,
The third closed beta test during the Spring Festival has been successfully completed. We have received a lot of enthusiastic feedback - some constructive criticism, and some warm encouragement. According to the feedback, we decided to officially launch the early access version of "Last Remains" today!

I'm sorry to have kept you waiting for so long. The production team members are very grateful for your enthusiastic participation during the test. We know that the current game still has many shortcomings, but the release of the EA version is by no means the end of our development. Next, in addition to advancing the development according to the original plan, we will continue to optimize and enrich the game content according to the mainstream opinions of the players. This is also the original intention of our choice of early experience - to work with the players to create a better "Remains".

In response to the feedback from the third test, the early access version has made the following optimizations and adjustments:
1. Server efficiency optimization: The problem of lobby page freezing has been significantly improved, and the fluency has been greatly improved.
2. Game balance adjustment:
(1) Balanced the experience of speed and strength.
(2) Mutation ability balance: Super strength can now cripple enemies. Enemies in the crippled state cannot use super run and super jump.
(3) The stamina consumption of super run and super jump has increased. When the stamina bar turns red, these abilities will be invalid. Stamina management becomes more important.
(4) The calculation bug of throwing damage has been fixed, and the combat experience is more fair.
3. Drop adjustment: "Pharmacies will definitely spawn medicines, and security companies will definitely spawn guns", and resource acquisition is more reasonable.
4. Added character box extraction: You can extract characters by spending gold coins and keys. The attribute growth limits of different characters are different. Of course, the official will not sell characters directly, everything depends on your good luck!
5. Added leisure field: the number of zombies and material drops are reduced accordingly, which is suitable for novice experience, but no ranking points will be obtained after successful evacuation.
6. Added equipment decomposition multi-selection function: batch operation is more convenient and resource management is more efficient.
7. Since the current version of the mall and advanced pass are not open, diamonds cannot be used. We will improve the relevant functions as soon as possible.

Future development plan:

1. Map expansion: The game map will continue to expand. Iconic locations such as Hongyadong and Chaotianmen are being produced. The scale of the game map in the future will be far greater than now. This cannot be given an accurate answer at present.

2. Random allocation of areas: After the map is expanded to a certain extent, we will introduce a random allocation mechanism for areas. Players may be assigned to different area maps when entering different rooms to increase the fun of exploration.

3. Random events: Random events such as zombie tides and special tasks will be added one after another, making every game experience full of unknowns and challenges.

4. Scene interactive gameplay: More interesting scene interactions and items will be launched one after another.
5. Chongqing regional characteristics: We will add more items, props and even voices with Chongqing characteristics.
6. Zombie types: Add different types of zombies including BOSS.
7. Equipment types: Add more equipment, such as crossbows.

Finally, thank you for the support and company of every player!
Every step of the growth of "Last Remains" is inseparable from your participation. The launch of the early access version is just the beginning. There is still a long way to go in the future, but we believe that as long as we have your support, we will definitely go further! Looking forward to meeting you in the game!

—— "Last Remains" Development team
